items: The accounting team requested a copy of the signed ____ before processing the first payment.
A signed 'contract' is the agreement that authorizes obligations and payment terms.
The warehouse manager updated the stock ____ after receiving the morning delivery.
'Inventory' is the record or supply of goods currently held in stock.
The recruiter scheduled a second ____ with the strongest applicant for Thursday.
An 'interview' is a formal meeting used to evaluate a job applicant.
The supplier sent a revised price ____ after the buyer changed the order quantity.
A price 'quotation' states the amount a seller proposes to charge.
The branch posted a job ____ for an experienced customer-service supervisor.
A job 'vacancy' is an available position that an employer wants to fill.
The hotel issued a full ____ after confirming that the reservation had been canceled in time.
A 'refund' is money returned to a customer after a cancellation or return.
The logistics team tracked the overseas ____ until it reached the distribution center.
A 'shipment' is a quantity of goods sent from one place to another.
The department prepared an ____ listing the topics for Monday's planning meeting.
An 'agenda' lists the subjects to be discussed at a meeting.
The property manager renewed the office ____ for another three years.
A 'lease' is a contract granting the use of property for a specified period.
The finance director reviewed the quarterly sales ____ before approving the new budget.
A sales 'forecast' is an estimate of future sales performance.
Customers who complete the online ____ will receive a discount code.
A 'survey' collects information or opinions from respondents.
The purchasing clerk attached the delivery ____ to the expense record.
A 'receipt' provides evidence that goods or payment were received.
The company offers a transportation ____ to employees who commute by train.
A 'benefit' is an advantage or form of compensation provided to employees.
The sales manager approved a special ____ for the customer because of the large order.
A 'discount' is a reduction from the normal price.
The hiring committee selected one ____ for the final reference check.
A 'candidate' is a person being considered for a position.
The vendor sent an electronic ____ showing the amount due and the payment deadline.
An 'invoice' is a bill requesting payment for goods or services.
The operations team conducted a customer-satisfaction ____ after the new service launched.
A 'survey' is used to gather responses about customer satisfaction.
The contract includes a three-year equipment ____ covering repairs and parts.
A 'warranty' is a written promise covering repair or replacement under stated conditions.
The company increased its advertising ____ before launching the new product line.
An advertising 'budget' is the amount of money allocated to promotional activity.
The manager asked for written ____ that the supplier could meet the revised deadline.
'Confirmation' is a statement or evidence showing that something is certain or agreed.
The warehouse imposed a temporary shipping ____ while the loading dock was being repaired.
A shipping 'restriction' is a limit or rule affecting when or how goods may be sent.
The consulting firm submitted a detailed project ____ including fees, staffing, and milestones.
A project 'proposal' describes a planned service or project for a client's consideration.
The hotel recorded a sharp increase in room ____ during the holiday weekend.
Room 'occupancy' is the proportion or number of rooms being used.
The service center keeps a complete repair ____ for each company vehicle.
A repair 'record' documents maintenance and repair history.
The manufacturer changed its packaging to comply with new labeling ____.
Labeling 'requirements' are rules or conditions that must be satisfied.
